page_title: NAP 0-3 INT | Napoli v Inter 03/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Davide Massa has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yann Sommer intercepts the ball.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
89' Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the right post.
89' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Yann Sommer, who makes a comfortable save.
87' That will be all from Natan who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Alessio Zerbin (Napoli).
86' Simone Inzaghi has decided to substitute Marcus Thuram and he is replaced by Marko Arnautovic (Inter).
86' Substitution. Matteo Darmian will be replaced by Yann Bisseck (Inter).
85' Marcus Thuram (Inter) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.

85' 0 - 3 Goal! Juan Cuadrado displays great vision and sends a pass to Marcus Thuram (Inter), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 0:3.
81' Napoli take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

81' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Napoli.
81' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
81' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
80' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Napoli force a corner. They send men into the box.
78' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Matteo Darmian (Inter) was quite harsh and Davide Massa didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
77' Substitution. Davide Frattesi (Inter) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Henrikh Mkhitaryan walks off.
77' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Denzel Dumfries will be replaced by Juan Cuadrado (Inter).
76' The game is interrupted now, Denzel Dumfries (Inter) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
75' The manager makes a subsitution with Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli) coming on for Eljif Elmas.
75' Walter Mazzarri has decided to make a change. Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) replaces Stanislav Lobotka.
73' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) for his blatant foul.
73' Davide Massa blows his whistle after Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
70' Wow, what an escape. Marcus Thuram (Inter) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
69' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) powers a header just wide of the right post following a cross into the middle of the box.
68' It will be a substitution. Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) is ready to enter the pitch as Matteo Politano walks off.

67' Ambitious effort from Lautaro Martinez (Inter). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
66' Carlos Augusto (Inter) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Davide Massa signals.
65' Inter keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
62' 0 - 2 Goal - 0:2! Lautaro Martinez tees up Nicolo Barella (Inter) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Alex Meret.
59' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
58' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.

58' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Yann Sommer is alert and denies him with a nice save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Napoli.
57' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
56' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) commits a rough foul. Davide Massa stops the game and makes a call.
54' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Marcus Thuram (Inter) heads on.
54' Matteo Politano (Napoli) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
50' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner which is cleared.
50' Nicolo Barella (Inter) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Inter force their opponents to concede a corner.
47' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Davide Massa has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) outjumps his marker inside the box and heads the resulting corner way wide of the right post.
45+2' Matteo Politano (Napoli) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

45+2' Matteo Politano (Napoli) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Napoli will take a corner kick.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

44' 0 - 1 Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight into the bottom left corner. He couldn't have done it any better. 0:1.
43' Matteo Politano (Napoli) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
39' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Alex Meret pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
36' Matteo Politano (Napoli) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the crossbar. Close!
34' Davide Massa has a clear sight and sees a foul from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter).
31' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
31' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) produces a killer pass onto Nicolo Barella, who loses the ball to one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Inter win a corner kick.
28' A dangerous looking corner kick from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is cleared to safety by the defence.

27' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Lautaro Martinez (Inter) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Inter get a corner.
24' Davide Massa blows for a foul after Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
23' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
23' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
23' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
19' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Yann Sommer makes a great save.
18' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Stefan de Vrij (Inter) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Carlos Augusto.
17' Stefan de Vrij (Inter) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
15' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
13' The goal by Inter won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
13' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Davide Massa is going to take a look using VAR.
12' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Marcus Thuram (Inter) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
9' The game is interrupted as Denzel Dumfries (Inter) is flagged offside.
5' Federico Dimarco (Inter) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
4' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Inter are going to take it.
3' Napoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
3' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going inside the right post, but Yann Sommer has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
